elements.name: ellipse-09 Toggle the curvature comb on an existing ellipse

steps.name: a copy of `fixtures/cad/ellipse/rotated-measured.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited in RIGHT view
the rotated ellipse has no curvature comb visible
the user right-click its curve and choose Display Curvature
a green comb appears around the ellipse
the user right-click its curve again
Display Curvature is checked and Setup Curvature Display is offered
the user click the checked Display Curvature option
the comb disappears and the ellipse remains visible
